_meta.purpose: Render/visualization asset. NOT spec.json, NOT a fabrication contract.
_meta.units: mm (converted once to metres in ww_lib.mm; scene scale_length = 1.0, 1 BU = 1 m)
_meta.world_frame: Z up, front = world -Y, tabletop at Z = 0
_meta.product_frame_P: origin C; rotate +40 deg about world X; localZ = rotor/opening axis at 50 deg elevation

shell.center_world_note: phase-1 clay vs concept: sphere sat too high on long legs; 95 -> 86 mm keeps the concept's low stance (bottom gap 16 mm). provisional_visualization_default
shell.rim_flat_note: flat rim r 52..54.5 at z 43.93; the inner cavity is truncated by a flat ceiling one wall (2.5 mm) below the rim (z 41.43, undercut ring to r 53.29) so the bore lip keeps >= 2.5 mm of wall (gate 2026-09-06). provisional_visualization_default
gate audit 13:20: bore met the outer sphere in a knife edge (wall screen min 1.06 mm); opening now has a 2.5 mm flat rim (r 52..54.5) under the bezel

front_rim.z0_note: seated on the new flat rim (z 43.93)

led.temperature_descriptor: 6500K descriptive only, not an exact equivalence

cushion.corner_radius_note: 8 mm chosen so the rounded corner (34.4 mm from axis) clears the 37 mm cup bore; sharp 45x60 corners (37.5 mm) would clash

stand.leg_note: phase-1 delta: 5/3 -> 6/3.5 mm radii, concept legs read chunkier

studio.tuning_note: first 512px preview (key 100 W @1.1 m, ground #8A8A8A) rendered mean luminance 0.76 with a hot floor spot; reduced by test render

service_cover.note: underside hatch; rear view stays clean like the concept; clears rear leg (polar 150 deg, +-4 deg) by ~2 deg

guilloche.rays_note: 128 (start) read as coarse 2 mm ribs in the Cycles crop; 240 rays ~1.1 mm pitch matches the concept's fine sunburst
